attack.title: Adversarial Threat Simulator
attack.subtitle: Test behavioral gating under simulated naive impostor and informed mimicry attacks
attack.scenario_a1_desc: Uninformed stranger pulling handle with arbitrary grip force and velocity.
attack.scenario_a2_l1_desc: Attacker who visually watched the owner open the safe and attempts to replicate timing.
attack.scenario_a2_l2_desc: Adversary trained on feedback, attempting coordinated velocity and force matching.
attack.fp_compromise_note: Simulates a silicone spoof or stolen template. Evaluates whether Gate 2 alone stops the breach.
attack.out_of_scope_note: Security Notice: Physical fingerprint spoofing (A3), signal bus tapping (A4), and destructive drills (A5) are outside behavioral gating evaluation.
attack.overlay_title: Attacker Signal vs Enrolled Owner Envelope
attack.overlay_desc: Dashed white = attacker attempt. Solid shaded band = genuine owner 95% confidence envelope.

settings.title: Device & Security Settings
settings.subtitle: Hardware security thresholds, timeout intervals, and local companion preferences
settings.privacy_p1: No raw fingerprint images or biometric templates are stored on this device or transmitted over Wi-Fi. Templates remain isolated in the onboard cryptographic secure module.
settings.privacy_p2: High-frequency load cell and IMU signals are processed strictly in ESP32 SRAM and ephemeral mock memory. Attempt logs store only scalar decision metrics.
settings.reset_demo_confirm: Reset all state, logs, and attempts to factory initial seed?
